author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
## Analysis Complete

**Status:** pe_fix_needed (duplicate of #585)

### Summary
PE matches YAML expected value ($4,321.50), but both are WRONG. TaxAct shows $4,141 after applying the $180 Iowa Child and Dependent Care Credit (CDCC).

### Root Cause
Same bug as issue #585: `ia_cdcc.py` uses `ia_net_income` (~$92,225) instead of `ia_taxable_income` ($89,125) for the percentage lookup.

- ia_net_income ≈ $92,225 → Falls in "$90,000 and over" bracket → 0% → CDCC = $0
- ia_taxable_income = $89,125 → Falls in "$40,000-$89,999" bracket → 30% → CDCC = $180

### TaxAct Child Credits Worksheet
| Line | Description | Value |
|------|-------------|-------|
| 1 | Federal Form 2441 CDCC | $600 |
| 2 | Iowa taxable income (IA 1040 Line 4) | $89,125 |
| 3 | Applicable decimal | 0.30 |
| 4 | Iowa CDCC | $180 |

### Fix
Already filed as [policyengine-us #6977](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/issues/6977). The fix will address both this issue and #585.
